precision.method: Exact Symbolica PV coefficients, oneloop NativeEvaluator<Float> A0-D0, exact integer inputs, native IREGI normalization

conclusion: Highprecision scalar masters and exact coefficient evaluation converge at128/256bits; both binary64 routes fail fixed1e-10 tolerance for this component. Requires precision rescue or explicit instability diagnostic.

conditioning.interpretation: About28bits of relative cancellation. Correctly rounded scalar master inputs greatly reduce the observed error; higherprecision scalar masters and a conservative instability monitor are needed.
